source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"Mainly a check of the nurse's travel arrangements and lodging rather than their professional qualifications","B":"Fairly minimal credentialing verification, on the assumption that the staffing agency handles most of that step","C":"Little more than a short introduction to the physical layout of the unit itself","D":"Licensure, certifications, and competency, along with facility-specific orientation"}}
source_row.rationale: Travel nurse onboarding should include verification of licensure, relevant certifications, and competency, along with facility-specific orientation, ensuring the same safety standards apply as for other staff.
source_row.source_name: The Joint Commission — Temporary Staff Credentialing Standards
